anatomy.flutter: Collapsible(open, trigger, content) -- a Column of [trigger, Unfold(open, child: content)], explicitly thin: 'this widget owns the stacking and nothing else', with all visible styling left to the caller's trigger and to Unfold.
anatomy.web: CollapsiblePrimitive.Root (data-slot=collapsible) > CollapsibleTrigger (data-slot=collapsible-trigger, asChild passthrough) + CollapsibleContent (data-slot=collapsible-content, overflow-hidden + animation classes).

api.flutter: Collapsible({open: bool, trigger: Widget, content: Widget}) -- fully controlled, caller owns the open/close callback on `trigger`.
api.web: CollapsiblePrimitive.Root's own open/onOpenChange/defaultOpen props passed through unmodified; CollapsibleTrigger/CollapsibleContent are near-bare Radix wrappers with only data-slot and (for Content) animation className added.

states.flutter: Unfold's AnimationController (value seeded to widget.open?1:0) plus a CurvedAnimation(curve: MotionCurves.emphasized, reverseCurve: FlippedCurve(MotionCurves.move)) drives heightFactor+Opacity together; didUpdateWidget seeks the controller to the opposite endpoint before running (_controller.value=1; _controller.reverse() when closing) so an interrupted animation replaces rather than reverses in place, matching the source note that 'a CSS animation that is swapped mid-flight starts its successor at that successor's own 0% stop'. MotionDurations.expand=420ms/collapse=250ms map to the web's --duration-open/--duration-normal, and MotionCurves.emphasized/move map to --ease-emphasized/--ease-move.
states.web: data-open:anim-expand / data-closed:anim-collapse utilities in styles/motion.css: anim-expand animates ds-expand over var(--duration-open) var(--ease-emphasized) with fill-mode backwards (not both -- a batch-4 fix so a panel's height stays auto after opening rather than pinned to the stale --unfold-h), anim-collapse animates ds-collapse over var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-move) with fill-mode both.

disabled.flutter: Collapsible itself has no disabled state -- the trigger is the caller's own control and carries whatever disabled behaviour that control has.
disabled.web: CollapsibleTrigger has no disabled styling of its own; disabled behaviour belongs to whatever asChild element the caller passes (e.g. a disabled Button).
disabled.note: Disabled is delegated entirely to the caller-supplied trigger on both platforms, so this dimension does not apply to Collapsible itself.

interaction.flutter: No interaction handling in Collapsible/Unfold themselves -- the trigger Widget is expected to already be wired to flip `open` (the page passes a Button variant=outline with its own tap/keyboard handling).
interaction.web: CollapsibleTrigger asChild hands all pointer/keyboard activation to Radix's trigger behaviour (Enter/Space toggle) on whatever element the caller supplies.

semantics.flutter: No semantics node of its own; relies entirely on the caller's trigger widget (e.g. Button) and on the panel's own content for accessible naming/roles -- Collapsible is intentionally unopinionated here just as it is for interaction.
semantics.web: Radix's CollapsiblePrimitive wires aria-expanded/aria-controls on the trigger and the content's id automatically; Collapsible itself renders no extra ARIA beyond what Radix's primitives already provide.
